notes.title: Regular update in July
notes.notes:
Due to preparations for the official version, after this update, we will reduce the update frequency and focus on the content of the official version.

You can join our Discord, where you can get the latest update information and participate in the game's test server.

*Due to the temporary inability to find a good translation method, translations in some languages have been temporarily removed.

New Additions

1. Weapon disable now supports faction disable.

2. A new character - "Alpha - 0" - has been added, which appears as a training character in the base.

3. Missing translations of "German", "Russian", and "Spanish" in some dialogues have been completed.

4. A new "Help" panel has been added: You can see the "?" icon in some UI elements. Click it to view the function introduction.

5. A hatred mechanism has been added. Enemies will prioritize locking on the unit that has dealt the most damage to them (hatred will gradually decay by a percentage).

6. Perfect dodges can now dodge self - harming projectiles.

Adjustments

1. The "First - Aid Kit" mechanism has been adjusted: The ammunition limit has been increased. Ammunition will no longer be naturally restored. Instead, full ammunition will be restored in each starting area. High - quality first - aid kits will also restore ammunition after killing a target.

2. Perfect dodges can now reset the number of jumps.

3. The number of weapon disable slots has been changed to 5.

4. The UI of the weapon and plugin catalog has been adjusted.

5. Weapons in the BOSS room can now be sold.

6. The secondary weapons generated by "Shiranui" will now drop as items instead of replacing the current secondary weapon.

7. The reward drops in the BOSS room have been improved.

8. Weapon \[Flood] adjustment: Attack speed will no longer be reduced during \[Overheat], and \[Flood] will be unable to attack during this period

Bug Fixes

1. Missing special effects of some enemies have been fixed.

2. Abnormal bullets of some enemies have been fixed.

3. Abnormalities of some plugins have been fixed.

4. The issue that the area was not cleared after passing through "Endurance Enhancement - Seven" has been fixed.

notes.title: June 2025 Update
notes.notes:
New content

1. Main interface update!

-Now the main interface of the game has been updated, and more characters and interactive elements will be gradually added in the future! I hope everyone likes the current interface.



2. Adjust the guide description of disabling plug-ins and weapons

-The game can disable weapons and plug-ins in the illustration interface. Now the disabled description and operation logic have been optimized to be more intuitive.



3. Adjust the plug-in illustration interface UI

-The arrangement of the plug-in illustration is now adjusted to be consistent with the backpack for easy viewing

-The weapon illustration has added a description of the unlocking method, which will be continuously optimized later



4. Added 8 plug-ins

-The effects of the plug-ins will continue to expand, and there are nearly 300 plug-ins at present, so stay tuned



5. Weakened the health recovery effect of "Lost-Teresa"

-Teresa's attack recovery effect on summons has been greatly reduced, and only 1 health value will be restored when hitting multiple targets



6. Adjust some descriptions

-Some plug-in effect descriptions have been changed, which does not affect the original effect



Fixed issues

1. NPC loss issue

2. Item retention issue when reading files across versions

3. Missing air wall in the survival area

4. "As expected" takes effect abnormally

5. Abnormal background music in the fifth chapter

-The BGM of the fifth chapter has been changed, I hope you like it!



Others

If you encounter a bug, you can use the bug feedback function in the game to quickly send bug information, and we will fix it quickly after receiving it!

You can also join our QQ group chat or Discord to get game development information!

Hope everyone has fun ~

notes.title: May Update and Optimization
notes.notes:
Optimization
1. Significantly reduced the game package size.
2. Optimized the game loading method.

New Additions
1. Added 10 plugins.
2. Added 2 parkour levels [BETA].
3. Added the Sp version of "Maiko".
4. Added the level - 4 effect of "Lin's Gaze".
5. Added 5 weapon affixes.
6. Added the "Powerful Enemy Challenge" mode to fight more powerful bosses.
7. Added a music player in the lobby.

Adjustments
1. Enhanced the effect of "Support V - Module Enhancement".
2. Adjusted the values of the "Shield" series of plugins.
3. Adjusted the quality of some plugins.
4. Slightly increased the activation interval of "Memory Metal" from 0.2s to 0.5s.
5. Adjusted the effect of Lin's third - level token "Messenger Badge".
6. Slightly reduced the rewards of the random gacha machine.
7. Slightly reduced the frequency of plugin rewards.
8. Adjusted the modules required to purchase weapons.
9. White - quality weapons will no longer have affixes.
10. Red - quality "Shield Batteries" and "First - Aid Kits" can continuously restore ammunition.
11. Adjusted the values of weapon affixes related to shields.
12. Adjusted the pre - attack wind - up of boss - level enemies.
13. Adjusted the damage type of part of the "P" attacks.
14. Adjusted the effect of the talent "Growth" to take effect a maximum of 30 times.
15. Adjusted the enemy content in the "Fighting Club".

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed the issue where "Acupoint Press" failed to display correctly.
2. Fixed the abnormal activation of "Overflow Conversion".
3. Fixed the issue where "Maiko's" attacks caused abnormal floating.
4. Fixed the incorrect restoration effect of the "Medical Pack".
5. Attempted to fix the issue of the game freezing caused by "Maiko's" clones.
6. Attempted to fix the issue of the game freezing when "V" is hit.
7. Fixed the issue of affixes being repeatedly stacked.
8. Fixed the abnormal death of enemies in the tutorial level.
9. Fixed the abnormal rewards in the boss room.
10. Fixed the abnormal counter - attack targets.
11. Fixed the abnormal cross - version save data.
12. Fixed the abnormal enemy damage.

notes.title: Spring update 0.6.3
notes.notes:
Additions:
1. Added 31 new plugins
2. Added a weapon "Thunder Core"
3. Added talents "Growth" and "Perfect Evasion"
4. Some weapons have new quality additions
5. Added Lin's level three talisman
6. Added exclusive terms for the weapons 'Mirror Calm Water' and 'Green Edge'
7. Added dialogue unlocked by V and Ying's favorability in the Cat Girl Bar
8. Added a new level 'Moon Shadow Tech', with 4 regular enemies and 2 Boss enemies

Adjustments:
Plugin related
1. Adjusted some plugin effects and quality, adjusted the invincibility state of summons in 'Summon [BETA]'
2. Reduced the knockback force of 'Shockwave'
3. Reduced the base damage of 'Bleeding-Self'
4. Buff 'Frostbite' effect adjusted to: Damage reduction decreased by 50%
5. Optimized some buff and term descriptions

Weapon related
1. Increased the precise block judgment time of the blocking katana, added damage to the enemy based on the current health percentage when perfectly blocking
2. Reduced the toughness consumption when attacking with the 'Magic Gun', weakened the extra damage of the fifth bullet
3. Adjusted the attack correction of 'Green Edge', increased base damage
4. Adjusted the invincibility level of weapons with charge during charging
5. Reduced the initial ammo of the 'Bubble Gun'
6. The effect of the term 'Binding' is adjusted to: Each layer reduces 10% damage increase

Enemy related
1. Slowed down the bullet speed of 'Chaos Defense Army-G3', 'Chaos Defense Army Commander', 'Sifu'
2. The buff duration when 'Sifu' is attacked while holding a shield is changed from 10s to 6s
3. Reduced the duration of Boss-Shadow, Scythe Barrage, and its base damage
4. Reduced the rigidity time caused by some attacks of 'P' and 'Sifu' to the player
5. Attempted to optimize Lin's special effects performance
6. Difficulty "Pure Blood 3" will trigger Boss battle logic changes, enhance the vulnerability effect of "Pure Blood 2"
7. Reduced the base health and attack damage of regular enemies and Boss in the second and third levels
8. Adjusted the number of monsters generated in some levels
9. Optimized Lin's special effects performance
10. Increased the NPC values in NPC co-fighting

Fixes:
1. Fixed the issue where the 'Battle-Hardened Body' plugin does not work in endless mode
2. Fixed the issue where some attacks cause abnormal floating of enemies
3. Fixed the issue where the module number is abnormal when entering a specific type of area
4. Fixed the issue where NPC data is abnormal in the NPC co-fighting area
5. Attempted to fix the issue of save conflict during version update
6. Fixed the issue where the goods on the bar cannot be normally consumed in the game when loading the game
7. Fixed the issue of abnormal level connection
8. Some miscellaneous small issues.
